questions_and_answers.answer: a. From the perspective of the 30-year old male, the monetary value of the event of surviving through the year is equal to -$161, and the monetary value for the event of not surviving is equal to $99,839.b. The insurance company makes a lot of profit by selling many such policies because the insurance company earns 21 dollars on each policy sold.
